name: hud_ui_timer_panel_update
description: HudUiTimerPanel::Update advances elapsed time while running, chooses the normal or unscaled frame delta by network state, refreshes HMS text, then runs base element timer update.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja renders the x87 float arithmetic as synthetic long-double temporaries; final byte matching should be checked with a HUD timer panel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ed20 validates the stopped flag gate, zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled branch, secondsStep multiplied by g_FrameDeltaTimeSec or g_Time_UnscaledDeltaTimeSec, elapsedSeconds store, UpdateHMSFromSeconds call, and final HudUiElement::Update call.
zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled is functionally equivalent and tier S under target zopt_get_network_enabled.
The native timer update smoke verifies normal-frame and network/unscaled elapsed-time advancement, formatted HMS text refresh, and the stopped path leaving elapsed time unchanged.
